# New Markings
I went through and ported over two thousand markings from other forks, including nearly 500 new hairstyles.
A lot of these forks are lil chuddies and make all markings available to all species, so I had to go through and guess what species some markings were for based purely off of names, so if you see a marking that doesn't fit a species, please let me know.
